title: Poor Quality
text: Poor Quality. This is a beautiful mold. It does however have quality issues. Molds like this for cookies, are finely finished with no burrs or rough places to catch the dough. This one has many finishing flaws in the sanding of the design. Every one of those little burrs will make it very messy and hard to get out a perfectly finished cookie. If I have time, I may take my dremel and try to fix it, but not in time to use it this year. As always, you get what you pay for.

features: How to Use: Put a light dusting of flour on your cookie dough before pressing as added insurance that the cookie will release perfectly. You need to press the outer mold on the dough, next put in inner mold and press down, finally take out the mold.

Materials: Made of BEECH. The mold has been handled with food safe mix of bee wax and flax oil. Before first use, Please use blend of food-grade mineral oil (for butcher blocks) and beeswax to ensure the mold works as well as possible.
Non-Stick Baking Molds: The wooden baking molds are easy to use and clean without excess residue.
Widely in Use: Our cookie cutters can also be used for clay or other soft materials such as cake or cupcake decorations, candy, chocolate, fudge, biscuits, jelly, handmade soap, candles, etc.
It can help you make beautiful patterns, it is very suitable for baking beginners to use, is the best gift for baking hobby. Mold depth 2-2.5cm.
